name: desktop-ui-verification
goal: Desktop browser scenarios pass with current catalogs and controls, correct image lifecycles and no overflow or browser errors.

steps.title: Identify the failing behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction.
steps.evidence: Baseline 418f9e426 reproduces the same 45 Desktop browser failures as 6f9dba967. Restore current contract behavior and standard flows, fix image URL errors and responsive overflow, then require the complete browser and repository checks.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the bug; name the scenario, fixture, lifecycle or assertion gap and reusable test change.
steps.evidence: Prior full checks stopped before Desktop E2E. Existing error and overflow guards detect the faults. Updated the standard scenarios and shared fixtures for seven categories, modal search, chat modes and access selection; added model search, decoded-image and immutable-chat assertions before product changes.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
steps.evidence: Frozen checkpoint c751db8d8: 190 UI passes, 8 UI failures; 6 unit passes, 4 unit failures. Immutable proof 964e0fe2ef62048e303281976678fd2bfaf86539738df51d7c0eaab77d82bc19. No stamp or capture-state setup errors. Earlier setup diagnostics remain retained.

steps.title: Implement the smallest repair without weakening the regression test.
steps.evidence: Reuse store permission, Svelte tick, local arrow icon and existing responsive rules; route default stays in its reader. Ten unit and four affected browser cases pass with no unexpected errors; three fresh screenshot states inspected. Frozen tests, fixtures and scenario remain unchanged.

steps.title: Rerun the same unchanged regression test at a separate fix commit with loop record --phase green; preserve passing proof.
Run relevant project checks and affected UI browser flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending until proof passes.
